Veda-pārāyaṇa (IA 12), priest who repeats the Veda at the Rāmeśvaram temple.
veda-vṛtti (SITI), tax-free land set apart for meeting the expenses of reciting, the Vedas.
vedi (EI 32), a seat; also a raised platform (cf. vedikā). [] See JBRS, Vol. XXXIX, Parts 1-2, pp. 43-44, 47; Ep. Ind., Vol. XXXV, p. 192.
vedikā (LL), a rail; also, a raised platform (cf. vedi). See Ep. Ind., Vol. XXXV, p. 192.
